newsitem.title: NORWAY: Nera signs 140 mln NOK Venezuela deal.
newsitem.headline: Nera signs 140 mln NOK Venezuela deal.

text.p: Norwegian telecommunications company Nera ASA said on Wednesday it had signed a 140 million crown contract for supplying CNH Communicationes de Venezuela C.A. with radio communications equipment.
Nera said in a statement that CNH was specialising in providing services for international companies in great need of communications, such as oil companies.
CNH is already using Nera's SDH/PDH equipment in building a national transmission network linking Caracas with Maracaibo in the west and Maturin in the east.
Under the contract, Nera will deliver various types of high and low capacity transmission networks this year and next year.
